name: Abridge
description: Abridge is an AI-powered clinical documentation platform that converts patient-clinician conversations into structured medical notes in real-time. Originally developed with input from UPMC and academic medical centers, Abridge focuses on generating evidence-linked documentation that shows exactly which parts of the conversation support each element of the note.

faqs.question: What makes Abridge different from other AI scribes?
faqs.answer: Abridge's key differentiator is evidence-linked documentation - each element of the generated note links back to the specific part of the conversation that supports it. This makes it easy for clinicians to verify accuracy and understand the AI's reasoning.

faqs.question: Does Abridge integrate with Epic?
faqs.answer: Yes, Abridge has deep native integration with Epic and is featured in the Epic App Orchard. Notes can be written directly into Epic without copy-paste. The integration supports real-time documentation.

faqs.question: How much does Abridge cost?
faqs.answer: Abridge is enterprise-priced and requires a custom quote. Typical pricing ranges from $150-300 per provider per month with volume discounts for large health systems. Pilot programs are available.

faqs.question: Is Abridge suitable for mental health practices?
faqs.answer: While Abridge can generate psychiatry notes, it's primarily designed for general medical specialties. Mental health-specific practices may benefit more from tools like Mentalyc or Upheal that specialize in therapy documentation.
